resources.name: Quantum chemistry package (PySCF, NWChem, ORCA, or equivalent)

access.notes: Any open-source DFT code that supports unrestricted hybrid functionals and Mulliken population analysis is acceptable. Examples: PySCF (https://pyscf.org/), NWChem (https://github.com/nwchemgit/nwchem), ORCA (https://orcaforum.kofo.mpg.de/).
